title: Weighted Fourier coefficient bound
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\delta,\varepsilon\in[0,1]$ with $\varepsilon\le\delta$, and let $f$ be a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube taking values in $[-1,1]$. Suppose every stable influence of $f$ at parameter $\varepsilon$ is at most $\varepsilon$. For every subset $S$ of coordinates with odd cardinality, $(1-\delta)^{|S|}\widehat f(S)\le\sqrt{\varepsilon}$, where $\widehat f(S)$ is the Fourier coefficient of $f$ at $S$.
hypotheses_covered: Every stable influence at parameter $\varepsilon$ is at most $\varepsilon$
The coordinate subset has odd cardinality
